items.claim: Chanel Dyer has strong Muay Thai and striking, and is big, tall, and aggressive.
items.quote: I like her Muay Thai. I like the way she strikes. She's big. She's tall. She's aggressive.

items.claim: Elise Reed does not match up well against tall, long, and strong styles.
items.quote: I think she is going to be too big, too strong, too long. And I do not think at least Reed does good against that style.

items.claim: Elise Reed got heavily outstruck in her fight against Denise Gomez.
items.quote: Elise Reed's last fight against Denise Gomez, she got pieced up.

items.claim: Wes Schultz is a Division 1 wrestler.
items.quote: Wes Schultz is a D1 wrestler.

items.claim: Gage Young is a well-rounded fighter who mixes things up well.
items.quote: I know Gage Young very well-rounded... He's a dog. He mixes it up. Well

items.claim: Marcio Barbosa has a high volume of first-round finishes.
items.quote: I think he got 15 15 or 16 of them in the first round or something like that.

items.claim: Marcio Barbosa has crisp boxing, throws well in the pocket, and is an efficient fighter.
items.quote: I just like what I see like he throws in the pocket. His boxing is Chris. He doesn't waste a lot of energ. He's just efficient, man.

items.claim: Chris Padilla has good pace and performs well everywhere including on the feet.
items.quote: I just think Chris has um good pace, good on the feet, good everywhere.
